name: Joe's Pasta
legends: Came here on a Friday and the cacio e pepe was unreal — best in the neighborhood. Cozy spot, a little cramped but worth it.
Grandma's ragu is the move. Portions are huge and the focaccia comes out warm. Service was slow but the food made up for it.

unsungBites.name: Grandma's Ragu
unsungBites.description: Slow-cooked beef shoulder, San Marzano tomatoes, pappardelle.
